Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>

CommitDate: Thu Oct 24 10:59:47 2024 +0100

    Bug 1857413 - Fix browser_subscribe.js by waiting for the right thing. r=mkmelin
    
    This `waitForCondition` call is just waiting for the right number of rows. There could be the right
    number of rows part-way through updating the tree, if a row gets added before the row to be removed
    gets removed, and this seems to be what happens in most if not all cases.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D226594

diff --git a/mail/base/test/browser/browser_subscribe.js b/mail/base/test/browser/browser_subscribe.js
index 2ed321e8f5b..b19ce785f6d 100644
--- a/mail/base/test/browser/browser_subscribe.js
+++ b/mail/base/test/browser/browser_subscribe.js
@@ -173,7 +173,10 @@ add_task(async function testIMAPSubscribe() {
   // Check our subscriptions changed.
 
   await TestUtils.waitForCondition(
-    () => imapRootRow.querySelectorAll("li").length == 3,
+    () =>
+      !folderPane.getRowForFolder(`${imapRootFolder.URI}/Baz`) &&
+      folderPane.getRowForFolder(`${imapRootFolder.URI}/Foo`) &&
+      folderPane.getRowForFolder(`${imapRootFolder.URI}/Foo/Subfoo`),
     "waiting for folder tree to update"
   );
